GRAMMAR.description: Subject-verb agreement, tense/aspect, voice, articles (a/an/the), prepositions, pluralization, pronoun agreement.

SYNTAX.description: Dangling modifiers, run-on sentences, sentence splitting/merging for clarity, parallel structure, subject-focus realignment.

COLLOCATION.description: Verb-noun, adjective-noun, and preposition collocations idiomatic to peer-reviewed academic prose.

PUNCTUATION.description: Academic punctuation, hyphenation of compound modifiers, en-dash for numeric ranges, Oxford comma consistency, CJK/EN punctuation normalization.

TERMINOLOGY.description: Enforcing glossary-mandated terms, fixing cross-section synonym drift, aligning bilingual terminology.

ABBREVIATION.description: First-occurrence expansion 'Full Name (ABBR)', consistent subsequent abbreviation usage, case/hyphen consistency.

REGISTER.description: Removing colloquialisms, contractions, promotional hype, absolute overstatements, or mismatched person/voice for target genre.

CHINGLISH.description: Replacing literal ZH-to-EN calques, redundant nominalizations, and misused logical connectors with idiomatic academic English.

CONCISION.description: Tightening wordy phrasing without removing any technical qualifier, scope condition, or quantitative detail.

HEDGING_PRESERVATION.description: Adjusting phrasing to faithfully preserve original epistemic certainty, causal vs. correlational distinction, negation scope, or conditional boundary.

HUMAN_FLAG_ONLY.label_zh: 仅标注待人工确认（未擅改）
HUMAN_FLAG_ONLY.description: Factual ambiguity, missing data/unit, source conflict, or glossary conflict flagged without fabricating or altering facts.

review_tiers.A_SAFE_MECHANICAL: Objective mechanical/terminology fix; low risk of semantic shift.
review_tiers.B_STYLE_REGISTER: Academic fluency, concision, or register improvement; meaning preserved, quick skim recommended.
review_tiers.C_HUMAN_CONFIRM: Potential ambiguity, material gap, conflict, or epistemic nuance; requires author sign-off.
